concerns.text: T002/T003 validate against `specs/001-predicting-molecular-fluorescence-quantu/contracts/processed_dataset.schema.yaml`, but the plan's Project Structure and data-model.md show the same truncated directory while the constitution uses `PROJ-218-predicting-molecular-fluorescence-quantu`. If the on-disk path differs, contract validation in T002/T003 fails on a path typo; state the exact repo-relative contract path once, canonically.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T005, T006, T007 vs plan.md Project Structure
concerns.text: Tasks write code to `code/models/gnn.py`, `code/config/`, `code/tests/` while plan.md specifies a `src/` layout (`src/models/`, `src/preprocessing/`, `tests/unit|integration|contract`). An implementer cannot satisfy both; the tasks are self-consistent but not self-contained against the plan. Pick one canonical layout (the constitution's `code/` requirement suggests tasks are right — update plan.md).

T002 is too coarse for one task: invalid-SMILES exclusion + ε-clipping + metadata capture + Murcko scaffolds + unseen-type detection + schema-conformant output + unit tests. Split (atomizer will handle) into e.g. parse/exclude, clipping, metadata/scaffold, unseen-type detection subtasks so each has its own verification.

T009 bundles IG attribution for every test molecule, fragment aggregation, top-20 ranking, AND a SHAP sanity check on 10 molecules. The SHAP-on-GNN sub-step is methodologically underspecified (SHAP for graph models has no standard kernel path) — name the concrete SHAP approach (e.g., `shap.DeepExplainer`/`KernelExplainer` on flattened node features) or the implementer must guess. Also coarse; split.

Verification says "the parity plot's points match the test-set predictions recorded in `data/results/metrics.json` generation" — metrics.json (per T007) contains aggregate metrics, not per-molecule predictions, so this check is not executable as written. Either have T007 also save per-molecule predictions (e.g., `data/results/test_predictions.csv`) and verify the plot against that file, or drop the point-matching check.

T013's verification ("executing the documented command on a fresh runner reproduces all artifacts") is not concretely checkable within the task: no named reproduction log or comparison procedure is specified. Add a deliverable such as `data/results/rerun_log.txt` recording artifact presence/hash comparison between runs so done-ness is verifiable.
